components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's honorific title (MR, MRS, MS or DR). Optional; when
            present it is prefixed to the owner's last name to form the
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and this value is returned as the composed address string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address,
            appended to 'addressLine1' in the composed address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid
            for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9()+\-.\s]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present, the owner's
            'ageBand' is derived from it against the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a
            household). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title followed by a space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title
                is on file.
              type: string
              example: DR Who
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the
                region derived from the owner's postcode, a hyphen, and HASH8 —
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the owner's
                normalized telephone concatenated with its last name. A stable
                identity derived from owner fields, with no sequence numbers.
              type: string
              example: NSW-3F2A9C1D
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: NSW-3F2A9C1D-M20
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customer code.
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a score derived from the owner's
                own fields: starting at 0, plus 2 when a contact email is on
                file, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes, plus 2 for a
                household of 3 or more, and plus 3 when the owner's tenure
                exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 mapped from
                the owner's membership points: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-

## Soft-delete for owners

The requirement was to make `DELETE /api/owners/{id}` a soft-delete: flag the owner `deleted` and keep the row, keep it readable via GET, default `deleted` to false on create, and have the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks ignore deleted owners.

**Changes, each in the layer where it belongs:**

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — added a persisted `deleted` boolean column with `isDeleted()`/`setDeleted()`. This is the single source of truth for the flag.

2. **DB schemas** (`db/{hsqldb,h2,postgres,mysql}/schema.sql`) — added a `deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL` column. The tests run under `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the column must exist in the schema script; a fresh insert defaults it to false.

3. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `deleted` property to the `Owner` response schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field and MapStruct maps it automatically. This is what surfaces `$.deleted` in the GET/create responses.

4. **`service/ClinicServiceImpl.deleteOwner`** — changed from `ownerRepository.delete(owner)` to `owner.setDeleted(true); ownerRepository.save(owner)`, so the delete flow marks and retains the record (returning the existing 204, which is 2xx).

5. **Duplicate/identity checks ignore deleted owners** — added a `!isDeleted()` filter to `ClinicServiceImpl.isHouseholdDuplicate` (the blocking identity check) and to `PossibleDuplicateDetector` (the soft-duplicate signal). Since deleted owners never exist in the other tests, this is a no-op there and only relaxes a block once the sole match has been soft-deleted.

I kept the change scoped to the duplicate/identity detection the spec calls out, reusing the existing `isDeleted()` predicate rather than duplicating filtering logic. Test result: `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — `coreSoftDeleteFlagsAndRetains` and `coreDeletedOwnerIgnoredByDuplicateCheck` both green.
